what: At each section head a wedge band (a base plate on top, and below it an accent-color wedge that thickens toward the right) sticks to the top of the screen, and the next section’s band rises from below to cover the previous one — each band carries tall vertical number tags (01, 02, 03…, hanging below the wedge), as many as the previous bands plus 1, so the stacked bands gain one more tag with each section. The section after a band is pulled up under the band by the overlap distance, so the band passes by while covering the section head

options.z: z-index of the first band, default 100 — each later band is 1 higher
options.--fx-band-h: Strip height (padding-bottom as a width ratio, via style), default 22.22% — phone 48%
options.--fx-overlap: Distance (via style) to pull up the next section after the band, default 25vw — phone 65vw
options.--fx-left · --fx-right: Height where the wedge top edge passes at the left and right ends (band ratio, via style), default 13% · 3%
options.--fx-panel · --fx-stripe · --fx-note: Background panel, diagonal and tag fills on the band (via style), defaults --kf-bg · --kf-accent · --kf-accent-soft
options.--fx-note-w · --fx-step: Note width (height is 1.86x) · gap between notes (via style), default 2.1vw · 4%
options.[data-fx-part=band]: Section header band (the direct child just below) — the next sibling is that section. Inside it [data-fx-part=If note] is placed manually, it isn’t created and is used as is
options.--fx-thick: Wedge right-end thickness (band ratio, via style), default 9% — left end is 2%

note: The original draws the three bands (notes of 1, 2 and 3 sheets) separately as image SVGs. The part builds the diagonals and notes in css and js, so notes grow along with the number of bands. It stays attached on phones too, so swap the band height and overlap for phone values
